name: orrery
description: Architecture and system design diagrams with official AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, GitHub and IBM icons, laid out automatically and rendered to SVG, PNG, draw.io, React TSX and HTML.
long_description:
Describe a system and Claude writes an orrery spec (a short YAML file), checks it, and renders it with the vendors' own icons. A measured review scores the diagram at the width readers see it and proposes spec fixes. Everything runs on your machine with no API key: the renderer, the icon catalogs and the fonts ship in the bundle, and only the optional logo and symbol sets download on first use.

Outputs: SVG (animated or still), PNG, editable draw.io, a React TSX component and a standalone HTML page, plus a link that opens the diagram in diagrams.net.

tools.name: get_authoring_guide
tools.description: The skill and spec reference to read before writing a spec.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Check a spec without rendering: errors, unknown icons, bad references and layout warnings, each with fixes.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render a spec to SVG, PNG, draw.io, editable draw.io SVG, a React TSX component or an HTML page.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Score the diagram at the width readers see it, with findings, evidence and spec fixes.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: What the laid-out picture shows in plain text: groups, nodes in reading order, edges and steps.

tools.name: icons_search
tools.description: Find icon ids across the official cloud packs, tech logos and generic symbols.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The bundled reference diagrams to start from.

tools.name: try_patches
tools.description: Review candidate spec patches and keep only those that raise the score.

tools.name: drawio_link
tools.description: A link that opens the diagram in diagrams.net, loaded and editable.
